title: RC16 and RC4 Compression-Horizon Slot Independence

research_height.transfer_path: The shared US30 range-compression estimator is tested at the two native horizons and clocks; signal dependence must transmit through simultaneous lifecycle occupancy and stressed joint losses before the nominal two-slot treatment can be questioned.

central_question: Are RC16 and RC4 structurally dependent enough in signal occurrence, simultaneous occupancy and stressed loss realization that treating them as two independent 4% portfolio risk units materially overstates diversification?

research_bundle.name: p4_signal_dependence_cp2_overlap_and_stressed_loss_transmission
lenses: mechanism: compare P4 same-date binary signal association and joint direction for RC16-RC4 against all other fixed-time US30 pairs
portfolio path: reconstruct four-period CP2 same-date birth density and exact interval overlap for the RC pair
transmission and falsification: compare stressed joint-loss incidence with marginal independence and eligible natural-control pairs, then cap date concentration

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 067 showed that the day-fixed lot clock does not create material within-day risk distortion. The unresolved shared-capital question is therefore not order sequence but whether two components built from one estimator genuinely provide two independent risk services.
why_now.connection_bridge: RC16 and RC4 both trade US30 M30 range compression, only thirty minutes apart, and together account for two nominal 4% risk reservations. A true duplicate would directly distort three-slot and 12% aggregate-risk interpretation.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 067 was Program 3 meso order-state timing. Unit 068 moves to Program 5 meso-to-macro strategy-family dependence, using signal ecology, interval occupancy and joint loss rather than capital-clock state.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain one later separately declared Lab candidate that tests RC-family risk-unit accounting while preserving both signals and executions. Do not implement, merge or promote automatically.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve RC16 and RC4 as distinct components and independent nominal slots; close without horizon, threshold, clock or pair rescue.
why_now.decision_if_partial: Record signal-family similarity without a portfolio accounting candidate if occupancy or adverse-loss transmission does not pass.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Long-only beta and feature-supply cards remain either partly subsumed by Units 063-065 or limited to two recent years; neither changes shared capital as directly.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Overnight drift and internal-index dispersion are connected to the benchmark question but do not yet change an existing component or risk contract without introducing a new sleeve or an n=4 regime claim.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Execution-cost and pending-order questions remain useful, but opening another Program 3 unit immediately after Unit 067 offers less perspective distance than the RC family risk question.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Long-horizon capital-stop feedback remains connected but would continue the same capital-clock mechanism just rejected intraday; it is not opened adjacently.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Selected because RC16-RC4 is the only remaining existing-data question that can directly change whether two current 4% reservations represent two independent portfolio risks.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Full compounding-rank attribution remains an observation gap because the retained binding journal covers only 564 of 2,235 closes; summary ranks cannot identify its causal path.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare every program and height. Do not automatically open an RC window, threshold, clock, direction, pair, slot-cap or component-removal variant.

semantics.shared_estimator: Both components call CalculateRangeCompression on US30 M30; RC16 uses window 16 at 13:30 and passes only feature >= 1.5 long, while RC4 uses window 4 at 13:00 and passes abs(feature) >= 1.5 in the feature sign direction.
semantics.risk_identity: Each admitted component requests its own planned 4% position-risk budget and contributes separately to the 12% aggregate-risk contract.
semantics.causal_limit: Shared formula ancestry alone is not economic redundancy; signal association must transmit to simultaneous risk and stressed joint loss.

frozen_reconstruction.candidate_selection: Select exactly one row per component/server date where signal_known=1 for RC16, RC4, Pressure and Return. Do not infer a signal from any signal_known=0 row.
frozen_reconstruction.signal_pair_metrics: On the common known-date intersection for each of the six pairs, compute binary pass counts, phi coefficient and joint-pass lift P(A and B)/(P(A)P(B)); joint direction concordance uses only dates on which both pass.
frozen_reconstruction.lifecycle_reconstruction: Within each independent CP2 period, market OPEN begins one component lifecycle and CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends it. Birth date is OPEN server date; stressed outcome is close value_b; loss means stressed outcome below zero.
frozen_reconstruction.interval_overlap: For every same-date RC16-RC4 birth pair, overlap minutes are max(0, min(close times)-max(open times)); overlap coefficient is two times overlap divided by the sum of both lifecycle durations. Pool all pairs without selecting result or direction.
frozen_reconstruction.loss_independence: For each pair, expected joint-loss dates equal joint-birth dates times each component's marginal stressed-loss probability over all of its active dates in the same scope. Ratio is observed divided by expected; period ratios use period-local marginals.
frozen_reconstruction.control_eligibility: A non-target US30 pair is an eligible outcome control when it has at least 12 pooled joint-birth dates and expected pooled joint losses at least 2.0. At least three of the five controls must qualify.
frozen_reconstruction.concentration: RC joint-loss dollar mass is the sum of absolute stressed losses of both RC components on dates when both lose; report its share of all RC negative stressed dollars and the largest date's share.

requirements: The RC pair has 165 common signal-known dates, each component passes on at least 20 dates and at least 10 dates are joint passes.
RC pair binary phi is at least 0.20 and joint-pass lift is at least 1.50.
RC pair phi exceeds the median of the other five US30 pair phis by at least 0.10.
At least 0.80 of joint RC signal directions agree.
At least 40 pooled RC joint-birth dates exist, at least five in each period, and joint-birth share among dates with either RC is at least 0.15 pooled and at least 0.10 in three of four periods.
At least 0.80 of joint-birth pairs have positive interval overlap and median overlap coefficient is at least 0.50.
Pooled RC observed/expected stressed joint-loss ratio is at least 1.25 and reaches at least 1.10 in three of four periods.
At least three natural-control pairs are eligible and the RC joint-loss ratio exceeds their median by at least 0.15.
RC joint-loss dates carry at least 0.20 of all RC negative stressed dollars and no single date carries more than 0.15 of the joint-loss mass.

fixed_verdict_rules.complete: PASS_STRUCTURAL_RC_HORIZON_SLOT_REDUNDANCY_RETAIN_ACCOUNTING_CANDIDATE when integrity, the complete mechanism gate and the complete portfolio-transmission gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.mechanism_only: PARTIAL_RC_SIGNAL_DEPENDENCE_WITHOUT_PORTFOLIO_TRANSMISSION_PRESERVE_DISTINCT_SLOTS when mechanism passes but transmission fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_material: NO_MATERIAL_RC_HORIZON_SLOT_REDUNDANCY_PRESERVE_DISTINCT_SLOTS when mechanism fails and integrity passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_RC_HORIZON_INDEPENDENCE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any pin, selected-row, lifecycle, control-density or numerical integrity condition fails.

decision_translation.complete: Retain one future isolated Lab candidate for RC-family risk-unit accounting; preserve both components and do not implement automatically.
decision_translation.mechanism_only: Record formula-family signal similarity but preserve two risk identities because shared portfolio risk did not transmit.
decision_translation.no_material: Preserve RC16 and RC4 as distinct components and independent nominal risk slots.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away after budget exhaustion.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before calculating any pair phi, lift, joint-pass, overlap, joint-loss or control metric.

One implementation-only correction is allowed only if aggregation stops before emitting any target or control association, occupancy or outcome metric. After any such metric is emitted, make no correction or rerun.
Do not select a direction, period, loss subtype, component subset or alternate pair/control after metrics, and do not create MQL, run Tester, query broker/account state or touch Live.
